name: dexcom_cgm
description: Dexcom CGM connectivity for the native Linkiir scripting API. Handles the three-legged OAuth authorization Dexcom requires, refreshes the rotating token pair, and reads dataRange and estimated glucose values over linkiir.link.web. Includes a single-row SQLite token store, because a user-authorized grant has to outlive the request that obtained it. Every call returns result or nil plus a classified error, and nothing raises. Connectivity only: readings are returned exactly as Dexcom sends them, with no cursor policy and no mapping into another system's model.
